reference_plane: Estimated unfiltered SM200C analyzer-input power through the measurement cable path; 0.1–2.1 GHz calculated by filter offset; no cable-loss correction

low.note: Withholding measured nodes tests a wider frequency interval than normal interpolation; not an accuracy bound.

gap.note: Withholding measured nodes tests a wider frequency interval than normal interpolation; not an accuracy bound.

high.note: Withholding measured nodes tests a wider frequency interval than normal interpolation; not an accuracy bound.

meaning: Low-band powers are calculated by filter offset from 5050 filtered observations, not direct unfiltered sweeps. Corrected-knot agreement is by construction, not independent validation. Above 2.1 GHz uses direct sweeps. Spot checks do not certify full-band accuracy.

filter_offset_correction.assumptions: Constant dB shift across amplitude at each frequency. Offset includes possible session/path drift. Separate five-frequency filter comparison is not used to fit these offsets.

direct_2p1GHz_overlap_check.note: Unflagged direct gap observations above the corrected-curve quality floor; not used to fit the corrected 2.1-GHz endpoint.
